title: PUT /push/live-activity-start request
description: Revision 10. This phone's push-to-start token for the round's Live Activity (iOS 17.2+, ActivityKit's Activity<RoundActivityAttributes>.pushToStartTokenUpdates), one per phone, not per tournament; a later one replaces it, and the same token on another device of the server is dropped. With it the server starts a fresh activity on a tournament whose activity (follows "tournament", live-activity-request.schema.json) iOS has ended, the next time something changes there. The push is APNs push type liveactivity, event start, attributes-type RoundActivityAttributes, attributes {key: "<tag>#<tournament id>", tournament, round, title (title with {n} filled in), format, roundTitle (title as sent), complete}, content-state as for an update, and an alert (title: the tournament's name; body: loc-key push_round_paired with the round). The phone then sends the new activity's own token with PUT /tournaments/:id/live-activity, follows tournament, as for one it started itself. The strings are the app's, in its language, because the activity is drawn without asking the app; each at most 100 characters, absent or empty ones get the English defaults ("Round {n}", "{done} of {total} results", "All results in"). DELETE /push/live-activity-start forgets it (the person switched the lock screen off); DELETE /push forgets it too. Account route: send it to the cloud, never to a hall laptop.

tag.description: The app's name for this server (its base, as PUT /push's tag): the first half of the activity's key.
